judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a planning artifact (`.lore/dod.md`) and two failing acceptance tests in a new test file (`src/orchestration/beforeSession-error.acceptance.test.ts`). It never touched `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to move `await hooks.beforeSession(session)` inside the `try` block, so the bug remains completely unfixed and the newly added tests fail. Furthermore, it made none of the required updates to `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` or `CHANGELOG.md`. Even the tests it wrote swallow rejections with `.catch(() => {})` instead of verifying that the caller still receives the rejection and that the hooks fire in order.
